REPORT
Date October 18, 1937.
Subject Shanghai Municipality Cotton Mill Workers' National Salvation
Association.
Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C. G...

In accordance with instructions from the Shanghai Municipal-
ity Workers Relief Committee, the Shanghai Municipality Cotton
Mill Workers' National Salvation Association, No.24 Foh Shing
Tsung, off Kiaochow Road, O.O.L., and its Eastern District
Branch, No.37, Lane 894 Ferry Road, have established respectively
a sub-office on their premises to register unemployed workers
of different trades. At the same time it will undertake a
re-registration of the unemployed cotton mill workers. It is
reported that this step is taken in order to unify the registra-
tion of the unemployed throughout Shanghai.
On October 17, 1937, the Association issued a notice which,
apart from conveying the above information, declares that those
who have properly registered with the organization will be given
an allowance to meet their food expenses.

With reference to the attached newspaper translation,
dated 14/10/37, to the effect that cotton mill workers have
formed a "Workers Dramatic Play and Chorus Group" with offices
in the premises of the Shanghai Cotton Mill Workers' National
Salvation Association, enquiries have been made and it has been
found that the Group in question is at present only in the
suggestion stage. It is the intention of Mr. Tsang Sz Ping
(張立平), a member of the All Shanghai Association for the
Support of Armed Resistance, at present supervising the
activities of the Shanghai Municipality Cotton Mill Workers'
National Salvation Association, to organize ten touring dramatic
and chorus groups of 20 persons each to stage plays and sing
songs of a national salvation nature at various country places
in an endeavour to awaken the country people to the importance of
the present national crisis. He, however, has found it ...

（批：Noted S.I. ... 19/10.）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE INTELLIGENCE BUREAU OCT 19 1937）

报告
日期：1937年10月18日。
主题：上海市棉厂工人救国会。
制作人：职员廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien） 转呈人：C. G...

遵照上海市工人救济委员会的指示，位于胶州路（Kiaochow Road）外、老靶子路（O.O.L.）附近的福兴村（Foh Shing Tsung）24号的上海市棉厂工人救国会，及其位于斐伦路（Ferry Road）894弄37号的东区分会，已分别在其办公场所设立分办事处，以登记各行业的失业工人。同时，该会将重新登记失业的棉厂工人。据报，采取此举旨在统一全上海的失业人员登记工作。
1937年10月17日，该会发布了一则通告，除传达上述信息外，还声明凡在该组织正式登记者，将获得伙食津贴。

关于附上的1937年10月14日的报纸译文，其中提到棉厂工人成立了“工人戏剧歌咏团”，办公地点设在上海市棉厂工人救国会内，经查询发现，该团目前仅处于提议阶段。全上海各界抗敌后援会会员、目前负责监督上海市棉厂工人救国会活动的张立平（Tsang Sz Ping）先生，意图组织十个巡回戏剧歌咏团，每团二十人，赴各地乡村演出具有救国性质的戏剧和歌曲，以期唤醒乡下民众认识当前国家危机的重要性。然而，他发现……

（批注：S.I. 知悉 ... 10月19日。）
（印章：上海公共租界工部局情报处 1937年10月19日）

October 14th 1937.

National Herald and other local newspapers:

COTTON WORKERS FORM DRAMATIC GROUP

In view of the fact that the staging of dramatic
plays and the singing of songs are the most effective means
of publicity for the salvation of the nation, cotton mill
workers have formed a "Workers' Dramatic Play and Chorus
Group," with offices at the premises of the Shanghai Cotton
Mill Workers' National Salvation Association, No.24 Foh
Shing Tsung (福兴村), corner of Kiaochow and Robison
Roads. It is learned that any cotton mill worker who
is interested in staging plays and singing songs may join
this Group.

1937年10月14日。

《国民日报》及其他本地报纸：

棉厂工人组建戏剧团

鉴于演剧和唱歌是救国宣传最有效的手段，棉厂工人成立了“工人戏剧歌咏团”，办公地点设在胶州路与罗宾森路（Robison Roads）转角处的福兴村（Foh Shing Tsung）24号上海市棉厂工人救国会内。据悉，任何对演剧和唱歌感兴趣的棉厂工人均可加入该团。

Date...October 17, 1937.
Subject Shanghai Municipality Cotton Mill Workers' National Salvation
Association - Eastern District Branch formed.
Made by Clerk Liao Chun Chien Forwarded by C C......

From enquiries it has been ascertained that the "Ewo
Cotton Mill Workers National Salvation Association" mentioned
in the attached newspaper translation dated 8/10/37 is actually
the Eastern District Branch of the Shanghai Municipality Cotton
Mill Workers' National Salvation Association, which is under
the control of the All Shanghai Association for the Support of
Armed Resistance. This Branch has an office at no.37, Lane
894 Ferry Road, and has for its object the prevention of un-
employed mill workers, who are poor and ignorant, from being
utilized by the Japanese for activities of a traitorous nature.
The Branch is at present undertaking the registration of all
workers previously employed in the different cotton mills in
the Eastern District and not only those of the Ewo Cotton Mill.
The following are on the standing committee of the Branch:
1. Zung Chien Ping (郑建屏), a worker of the Ewo Cotton
Mill.
2. Siao Dah Ching (萧大慶), -ditto-
3. Wong Ah Ling (王阿林), a worker of the Doong Shing
Cotton Mill, 2086 Yangtsepoo Road.

Liao Chungchien
Clerk

3. 王阿林（Wong Ah Ling），杨树浦路（Yangtsepoo Road）2086号东盛棉厂（Doong Shing Cotton Mill）工人。

Lih Pao and other local newspapers: 9.10.37 (p.m.)
EWO COTTON MILL WORKERS' NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION TO
BE INAUGURATED ON OCTOBER 10

The Ewo Cotton Mill formerly employed 20,000
workers, but due to the mill being located in the war zone
in the Eastern district, these workers have been rendered
idle and unemployed.
About 1,000 of these workers were registered
with the Shanghai Cotton Mill Workers' National Salvation
Association and some 30 representatives were elected from
this group to form a national salvation association which
is to be formally inaugurated on October 10.
pages.zh:
《立报》及其他本地报纸：1937年10月9日（下午）
怡和棉厂工人救国会将于10月10日正式成立

怡和棉厂以前雇佣了两万名工人，但由于该厂位于东区战区，这些工人被迫闲置失业。
其中约一千名工人已在上海市棉厂工人救国会登记，并从这群人中选出了约三十名代表，组成一个救国会，定于10月10日正式成立。

September 29, 1937.

Shanghai Cotton Mill Workers National Salvation
Association - meeting

Nine committee members of the Shanghai Cotton
Mill Workers National Salvation Association held a
meeting in their office in the Yu. Jih Chang Primary
School, 809 Tonquin Road, at 9 a.m. September 28
with Li Dzu Tang (李绪堂) presiding. The following
resolutions were passed :-

1) That a report be submitted to the Shanghai Various
Circles Committee to Support Resistance against the
Enemy regarding the eight hundred unemployed workers
who have registered with the association and who
are in need of immediate relief.

2) That ten groups, each consisting of ten persons, be
formed to carry out propaganda work in the interior.
pages.zh:
1937年9月29日。

上海市棉厂工人救国会——会议

上海市棉厂工人救国会的九名委员于9月28日上午9时，在通肯路（Tonquin Road）809号育日昌小学（Yu. Jih Chang Primary School）的办公室举行会议，由李绪堂（Li Dzu Tang）主持。通过以下决议：

1) 向上海各界抗敌后援会提交报告，说明已向该会登记并急需紧急救济的八百名失业工人的情况。

2) 组建十个小组，每组十人，赴内地开展宣传工作。

Extract from Intelligence Report
of 24.9.37

Shanghai Municipality Cotton Mill Workers' National
Salvation Society - new body formed

A "Shanghai Municipality Cotton Mill Workers' National
Salvation Society" has recently come into existence with an
office at No.809 Tonquin Road. The aim of the Society is
to devise ways and means for the relief of the cotton mill
workers at present in Shanghai who have been thrown out of
work owing to hostilities. Mr. Tsang Sz Ping, a member of
the Shanghai Various Circles Committee to Support Resistance
against the Enemy is in charge of the organization.

摘自1937年9月24日的情报报告

上海市棉厂工人救国会——新团体成立

最近成立了一个“上海市棉厂工人救国会”，办公地点位于通肯路（Tonquin Road）809号。该会的宗旨是为目前在上海因战事而失业的棉厂工人谋划救济之道和方法。上海各界抗敌后援会会员张世平（Tsang Sz Ping）先生负责该组织的运作。

REPORT

Subject Inauguration of mill workers Federation.

Made by D.S.I. Burton Forwarded by [签名] Inspt. i/c.

Sir,
At 5 p.m. on the 28.9.37, C.D.C. 145 reported that he had received information that on the 22nd inst. a union named the Shanghai City Cotton Mill workers salvation Federation had been established in the Yu Zuh Tsong Ping Ming Primary School at 809 Tonquin Road which was conducted and organized by the Shanghai City Resistance Association. From enquiries it was learned that this federation be conducted by one named Tsang S Ping (張世平) head of the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai City Resistance Association.

The following were appointed members of a standing committee
1. Lee Hsu Dong (李靖堂), former worker of Sang Sing No 9 Mill
2. Yu Tsoo (余超), Kung Dah Mill worker.
3. Zang Keu Yu Lai(上官友蘭), N...K, Mill
4. Woo Lieu Ying (吳蓮英), N.W.K. No. 7 Mill.
5. Dung Sim Ching (鄧修清), Dah Foong Mill.
6. Zau Fah Yoong (趙法勇), -do-
7. Lee Yuen Dee (李運典), -do-
8. Hoong Shu Tsung(洪樹聰), N.W.K. No. 5 Mill.
9. Hoo Chien Ying (胡劍英), Sung Sing No. 9 Mill.

The object of the above federation is to register the unemployed workers in the Eastern and Western districts of Shanghai After workers have been registered a report will be forwarded to the Shanghai City Resistance Association for necessary steps to be taken for their relief by either giving them employment or sending them back to their native places.

报告

主题：工厂工人联合会成立。

制作人：副督察伯顿（D.S.I. Burton） 转呈人：[签名] 主管督察。

先生，
1937年9月28日下午5时，中央巡捕房145号报告称，他收到消息，本月22日，一个名为“上海市棉厂工人救国联合会”的工会在通肯路（Tonquin Road）809号育祖宗平民小学（Yu Zuh Tsong Ping Ming Primary School）成立，该会由上海市抗敌协会组织和领导。经查询得知，该联合会由上海市抗敌协会宣传部部长张世平（Tsang S Ping）领导。

以下人员被任命为常务委员会成员：
1. 李靖堂（Lee Hsu Dong），前三新九厂（Sang Sing No 9 Mill）工人
2. 余超（Yu Tsoo），公大纱厂（Kung Dah Mill）工人。
3. 上官友蘭（Zang Keu Yu Lai），N...K, 纱厂
4. 吳蓮英（Woo Lieu Ying），N.W.K. 七厂工人。
5. 鄧修清（Dung Sim Ching），大丰纱厂（Dah Foong Mill）。
6. 趙法勇（Zau Fah Yoong），同上。
7. 李運典（Lee Yuen Dee），同上。
8. 洪樹聰（Hoong Shu Tsung），N.W.K. 五厂工人。
9. 胡劍英（Hoo Chien Ying），三新九厂（Sung Sing No. 9 Mill）工人。

上述联合会的宗旨是登记上海东西两区的失业工人。工人登记后，将向上海市抗敌协会提交报告，以便采取必要措施进行救济，要么为他们提供就业，要么将他们送回原籍。

Regulations of Shanghai City Mill Workers Salvation Union.
Chapter 1. Principal.
Art. 1. This union be named the Shanghai City Mill workers
Salvation Union.
2. With the spirit of the three people principals the union
of mill workers undertakes national salvation welfare
and the improvement of the personal prospects of mill
workers.
Chapter 2. Organization.
3. That a mass meeting be held representatives selected and
resolutions adopted. After the meeting, the representatives
will be the supreme authority. After the representatives
meeting closes, the executive committee will be in
supreme authority from which standing committees will be
selected to assist the union to deal with affairs.
4. That the union will select 21 members for the executive
committee also 9 candidates, 9 members for a standing
committee and 3 candidates.
5. That this union will select a chief officer from the
standing committee in order to deal with the daily affairs
of the union.
6. That this union be composed of 5 sections namely General,
Organization, Propaganda, working, guidance, and Social
Intercourse. With the exception of the Social Intercourse
Section which will have one chief officer and 2 super-
visors, the other sections each to have only one chief
officer.
7. That a mass meeting be held once each year, the represen-
tative to meet twice a year, the Executive Committee once
per month and standing committee once a week. In case of
necessity, the Executive committee will have the power to
hold an emergency meeting. When one third of the members
request a meeting, it shall also be granted.
8. When the standing committee reach an appointed date, the
union members will again elect the new committees.

上海市工厂工人救国会章程。
第一章 总则。
第一条 本会定名为上海市工厂工人救国会。
第二条 本会以三民主义精神，承担救国福利及改善工厂工人个人前途之责任。
第二章 组织。
第三条 召开群众大会，选举代表并通过决议。会后，代表为最高权力机构。代表会议闭会后，执行委员会为最高权力机构，从中选出常务委员会协助本会处理事务。
第四条 本会选举执行委员二十一员，候补九员；常务委员九员，候补三员。
第五条 本会从常务委员会中推选主任一人，以处理本会日常事务。
第六条 本会下设五股，即总务、组织、宣传、工作指导及交际股。除交际股设主任一人、干事二人外，其余各股均只设主任一人。
第七条 群众大会每年召开一次，代表会议每半年召开一次，执行委员会每月召开一次，常务委员会每周召开一次。如有必要，执行委员会有权召开紧急会议。当三分之一成员要求开会时，亦应予以批准。
第八条 常务委员会任期届满时，本会会员将再次选举新一届委员会。

Chapter 3 Service.
9. That every male or female worker who wishes to assist the union
and the organization can be made a member of the union by being
recommended by two members.
10. That when one joins the union, he or she shall register and

After this is done, a number member card can be obtained from

Chapter 4. Right.
11. That each member of the union to have the powers of voting and
balloting.
12. That each member can be helped when necessary.
Chapter 5. Remarks.
13. That each member shall obey the regulations of the union.
14. That a member will be dismissed or punished for his or her
misbehaviour in preventing the development of the union.
15. That when a member can prove that a standing committee's
neglect of duty or the preventing of the development of
the union at an emergency meeting, the standing committee
will be disqualified, when two thirds of the members agree..
16. That The regulations of the union will be effective from the
date of distribution.
17. That regulations will be amended at mass meeting when necessary.
